summary: Backend GET/PUT /api/panificio/state: 6/6 pytest pass (persistence, updated_at, id forced to 'demo', 422 validation). Frontend (mobile 390x844 + tablet 1024x768): seed path after empty PUT works (4 recipes/4 notes/5 batches/5 stock/3 returns), sync badge shows 'Cloud sincronizzato' / 'Offline', note publish persisted to backend, shift filters correct, allergen modal (descending weight + GLUTINE legend), advance-b4 Da Impastare->In Puntata persisted and survives reload, trace-b1 HACCP sheet (lots, signatures, print-trace), Reports 3 charts + 7 waste bars, offline queue retries and flushes after reconnect, Reset Demo restores backend seeds. No overflow on tablet; kanban horizontally scrollable. ONE REAL BUG: polling overwrites unsynced pending edits and badge falsely shows 'Cloud sincronizzato'. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). SafeArea handled via useSafeAreaInsets.

minor.issue: updated_at format inconsistent: PUT returns tz-aware '...806407Z', GET returns naive '...806000' (no Z, ms precision; Mongo drops tzinfo). Use tz_aware=True on AsyncIOMotorClient or serialize as ISO string.

Whole-document last-write-wins with no version/updated_at check: two tablets editing concurrently will silently overwrite each other's changes. Consider optimistic concurrency (send base updated_at, reject 409 if stale) or per-collection patch endpoints.
Nested items typed as List[dict[str, Any]] - no schema validation of notes/batches/stock/recipes; no auth so anyone can wipe state.
Still routed to frontend (returns text/html) - old test_panificio_api.py::test_health_and_state_round_trip still fails because of this (known/bypassed).

ui_bugs.issue: REPRODUCED: with PUT failing (GET ok), advance-b4 -> UI shows 'In Puntata'; at ~12s poll returns stale remote state, UI REVERTS to 'Da Impastare' and badge flips to 'Cloud sincronizzato' while the change is still pending/unsaved. If the user edits again before retry flush, enqueueSave replaces `pending` with the remote-based state -> offline edit permanently lost. Same can happen in real offline when connectivity returns between flush failure and retry (fetch timeout 8s + 10s retry > 12s poll). Fix: in pollRemote, if `pending` !== null (or saveTimer/retryTimer active) skip applying remote and do not set status 'online'; optionally trigger flushPending() instead. Reference: /app/frontend/src/utils/sync.ts:110-122, /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:63-70

integration_issues.issue: SectionTitle actions without onAction do nothing: '+ Nuovo lotto', 'Vedi produzione', '+ Registra lotto', '+ Check', '+ Registra reso'; 'Registra rinfresco' Pressable has no onPress; HACCP banner shows chevron but is not pressable.

issues: advance-* (74x32) and trace-* (99x32) buttons below 44pt min touch target
Batch card buttons wrap onto 2 lines on tablet columns (210px) - fine but cramped

Caption date hardcoded 'Laboratorio · 18 Giu 2026' and Dashboard 'Ultimo aggiornamento 08:42' hardcoded, while traceability sheet uses real date (24/11/2026) -> inconsistent; drive from updated_at / current date
New notes persist time: 'Adesso' forever - after reload/next day still says 'Adesso'. Store ISO createdAt and format relative time.

Charts are pseudo-dynamic: planned/actual derived from batches.length*42+recipes.length*7 modulo formula, waste trend synthesized from today's total; 'Waste medio' = totalWaste*0.7 shown as '%' (unit mismatch). Waste chart has no day labels. Flour mix labels lowercase ('tipo 0', 'integrale').

action_items: HIGH: Fix pollRemote race in /app/frontend/src/utils/sync.ts - skip applying remote/setting 'online' while a save is pending or retry is scheduled (export a hasPending() or check `pending` inside pollRemote).
Make updated_at consistent (tz-aware) between GET and PUT in /app/backend/server.py.
Consider optimistic concurrency on PUT (multi-tablet last-write-wins data loss).
Store note createdAt ISO instead of static 'Adesso'; replace hardcoded header date / 'Ultimo aggiornamento 08:42'.
Increase advance/trace buttons and mode chips to minHeight 44.
Wire or hide dead actions (+ Nuovo lotto, Vedi produzione, + Registra lotto, + Check, + Registra reso, Registra rinfresco).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 350 lines but with extremely long single-line JSX components (lines up to several KB) - split Dashboard/Recipes/Production/More/Reports/modals into separate files under src/screens.
Poll useEffect depends on [loaded, state] so the interval is torn down/recreated on every state change; continuous editing delays polling indefinitely. Use a ref for current state.
loadInitialState: if backend returns empty recipes it pushes the seed and ignores a non-empty local cache (offline edits lost after backend wipe).
remainingFromIso progress uses a fixed 180-min assumed window - progress bars are not real stage durations.
Returns list uses key={item.product}; Recipes ingredient key={ingredient.name} - duplicates possible.

AllergenModal/TraceabilityModal on web render absolute overlay inside appShell rather than Modal - OK in preview but backdrop doesn't cover full viewport when maxWidth shell is narrower than window on large desktops.

rca_of_issue: pollRemote() in sync.ts unconditionally fetches remote, sets status 'online' and returns remote state if it differs from current; index.tsx applies it via setState. It is unaware of the module-level `pending` queue, so any unflushed optimistic edit is overwritten in the UI by the older server copy and the badge misreports sync. Mitigation: guard pollRemote with `if (pending) return null;` (and don't setStatus('online') while pending), or merge by updated_at.
